thread:
Elena (CEO): Quick Friday check-in from me. Top asks for next week: 1) finish Private GA checklist (security sign-off + customer docs), 2) reduce hosted unit cost target by ~18% (engineering owners below), 3) propose Dedicated SLA wording (aiming for 99.9% with defined MTTR), 4) short incident follow-up from last night's EU edge blips. Please call owners and 1-3 line actions.

Raj (VP Eng): We'll take the cost initiative. Plan: batching + kernel tweaks this week, routing policy changes next, and a limited quantization experiment on staging. I'll post a delta estimate by EOD.

Maya (VP Product): Private GA docs mostly done; need Security to OK the privacy/playbook language. I'll circulate the public-facing doc for sign-off Monday AM.

Jordan (SRE): Incident summary: between 02:10-03:05 UTC the EU edge proxy hit high memory leading to connection churn and elevated p50/p95 latency. deploy-bot alerted at 02:14. We rolled the proxy pool and health returned at 03:05. Impact: brief 10-15m tail latency increase for routed customers, no token loss.

deploy-bot: ALERT edge-proxy-eu: mem_rss > 90% on 3 hosts

Jordan (SRE): Root cause likely a buffer leak in the proxy lib when gRPC keepalives align with long-lived client streams. Immediate actions: pin proxy lib to 1.4.2 (rollback), add mem/kv pressure alerts, run a focused canary against Dedicated pool. Owners: Jordan (pin + alerts), Raj (canary). Postmortem draft Tue.

Priya (Finance): Cost target: please include $ estimates and risk bands. -18% is doable with batching + quant, but we need conservative/likely/optimistic numbers for next week's finance sync.

Raj (VP Eng): I'll attach a short spreadsheet. Expect batching+kernel: ~10% savings (low risk), cache/routing: ~5-7% (medium risk), infra reclaim: ~1-3% (higher risk).

Liam (Head of Sales): Sales note: several pilot customers are waiting on Private GA timing and SLA text. If we can confirm SLA language this week, we can accelerate two conversions.

Elena (CEO): Prioritize GA sign-off and SLA wording. Jordan/Raj thanks for the quick mitigation. Keep the postmortem terse: what happened, impact, mitigation, next steps, owners. Priya: add a conservative estimate for finance.

Maya (VP Product): I'll draft customer communication about the incident and GA timeline; sharing Monday.

Elena (CEO): Final: please block 30m Monday for a rollup — cost levers, GA readiness, incident actions. We'll use that to confirm go/no-go milestones. Happy weekend, team. :raised_hands:
